title: Mirabel and the Aftermath
author: Tamsin Vane
blurb: Cyrus Nystrom, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
